title: Global search ranks the whole journal from a build-time index
description: Every page gains a header search box backed by a build-time full-text index of article bodies, with a dedicated results page that ranks title matches first, then excerpts, then body text. Queries stay in the address bar, shortcuts focus and clear, and the per-listing filters keep working.
lead: The journal can finally be searched instead of skimmed: a header box on every page queries a full-text index built with the site, and a dedicated results page ranks title matches first, then excerpts, then body text. Body-only words that the old per-listing filter never saw now resolve to the right article, queries survive reloads and shares, and readers without scripts still get a working form.

stages.rationale: Shipped the build-time index, the header box, the results page, the ranked client, the extended browser contract, and this entry.

reasoning.DEV: The builder emits a deterministic full-text index from plain article bodies with no chrome, and the results page ranks title matches above excerpts, topics, and body text with newest-first ties. The header form degrades to a plain query request without scripts, while the client adds debounced rendering, address-bar queries, focus and clear shortcuts, and live announcements. The full suite stays green, including new browser checks for body-only terms on every page kind.
